fullDescription: Neo-brutalist signup landing page: acid-yellow accent on off-white paper, thick black borders, hard offset shadows, uppercase Archivo Black type, a marquee ticker, and a name/email/password sign-up card as the hero.
prompt:
## Resumo
A neo-brutalist signup landing page that pairs a punchy left-hand pitch with a self-contained sign-up card on the right. Off-white paper background, pure-black ink, and an acid-yellow accent. Everything is built on heavy 3-4px black borders, hard offset drop-shadows (no blur), uppercase display type, and a marquee ticker. The form is the hero: name / email / password, a big acid CTA, a Google option, and a 'free, no card' reassurance line.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a neo-brutalist / acid-brutalist style. Palette: paper off-white background #f4f1ea, pure-black ink #000000 for all text/borders, one electric acid-yellow accent #e8ff00 for highlights/CTAs/badges, white #ffffff for input fields, placeholder grey #6b6b6b, and faint grid lines at #0000000d. Type: 'Archivo Black' for display headings (huge, uppercase, tracking-tight, leading ~0.94), 'Archivo' (weights 400-900) for body and labels, 'Space Grotesk' as the monospace voice for tickers/badges/eyebrows (uppercase, wide letter-spacing). Every surface gets a solid black border (3px on small chips/inputs, 4px on cards/buttons) and a hard offset shadow with NO blur: small = 4px 4px 0 #000, base = 6px 6px 0 #000, large = 10px 10px 0 #000, plus an acid variant = 6px 6px 0 #e8ff00, 6px 6px 0 2px #000. Sharp 90-degree corners everywhere, zero border-radius. Interactions are physical: on hover a 'press' element translates -2px,-2px and its shadow grows to 8px 8px; on active it translates 3px,3px and the shadow shrinks to 2px 2px; focused inputs nudge -1px,-1px and gain a 5px 5px hard shadow. Faint 28px x 28px paper grid behind hero sections. Headline phrases get an acid-yellow highlighter knockout (box-decoration-clone). Mood: confident, loud, anti-corporate, hand-built indie.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header on paper #f4f1ea with a 4px black bottom border, 64-72px tall, max-w-6xl inner row. Left: a wordmark = a 36px acid-yellow square with a 3px black border, small hard shadow, holding a black 'F' in Archivo Black, then 'FORMSET' in heavy uppercase tracking-tight. Center (md+ only): nav links 'How it works', 'Prompt library', 'Pricing' in semibold ~15px. Right: a 'Log in' text link with a 2px underline that gets an acid highlight on hover, and a 'Start free' button = black fill, paper text, 3px black border, small hard shadow, with the 'press' physical hover.

### Acid marquee ticker
A full-bleed strip in acid-yellow #e8ff00 with a 4px black bottom border, overflow hidden. Inside, a horizontally scrolling marquee (CSS keyframe translateX 0 to -50%, ~22s linear infinite) of uppercase Space Grotesk bold ~13-14px phrases separated by a small star glyph (✺): 'No credit card', '100 free generations', 'Infinite canvas', 'Idea -> shippable UI', 'Drive it from your coding agent'. Duplicate the run twice so the loop is seamless.

### Hero - left pitch column
On a faint grid-paper background, a max-w-xl pitch column. Top: a small uppercase eyebrow chip 'AI PRODUCT DESIGN AGENT' in mono bold ~12px, acid-yellow fill, 3px black border, small hard shadow. Then a giant Archivo Black headline (44-68px responsive, leading 0.94, tracking-tight): 'Make the account.' on line one, then 'Then make the work.' wrapped in an acid-yellow highlighter knockout. Below, a ~18-20px medium body paragraph. Then a 3-item checklist: each row is a 28px black square with an acid-yellow check glyph and a 3px border, followed by semibold copy ('Prompt on the web, or drive it from Claude Code / Cursor', '2,000+ starter prompts in the open library', 'Export clean, shippable markup'). Finish with a social-proof row: four overlapping 36px bordered squares (acid/paper/ink/acid) and '57,000+ builders shipping faster'.

### Hero - signup card (the centerpiece)
A self-contained sign-up card, max-w-md, justified to the right edge on desktop. Card: paper #f4f1ea fill, 4px black border, large hard shadow (10px 10px 0 #000), ~28-36px padding. A rotated '60-SEC SETUP' badge (black fill, acid text, lightning icon, mono uppercase, small hard shadow) sits at the top-left corner, rotated about -8 degrees, only on desktop. Card header row: 'SIGN UP' in Archivo Black ~28px uppercase on the left, a small acid 'FREE' chip with 2px border on the right, separated by a 4px black bottom border. Form: three stacked fields (Name / Email / Password), each with an uppercase Archivo Black ~14px label and a white input with a 3px black border + small hard shadow; on focus the input nudges -1px,-1px and the shadow grows. Placeholders in grey #6b6b6b. Primary submit button: full-width acid-yellow fill, 4px black border, base hard shadow, Archivo Black uppercase ~18px, label 'Sign up & start designing ->', with the press interaction. Then an 'OR' divider made of two 3px black rules flanking a mono 'OR'. Then a white 'Continue with Google' button (3px border, small hard shadow, Google logo). Footer line: 'Have an account? Log in here!' with a bold underlined link. Below the card, a centered mono ~12px uppercase reassurance: 'By signing up you agree to the terms. No card required.'

### How it works - black band
A full-bleed black section (#000000 bg, paper text) with 4px black top/bottom borders. Header row: a huge Archivo Black headline 'Three steps.' then 'No artboard anxiety.' (the second line in acid-yellow), with a mono uppercase support line on the right. Below, a 3-column grid of step cards: cards 01 and 02 are paper-filled black-text with an acid hard-shadow (shadow-hard-acid); card 03 is acid-filled with a plain black hard shadow. Each card: a giant Archivo Black number (01/02/03), an uppercase card title, and a short body line.

### Library strip
On grid-paper, a section header with a mono 'THE LIBRARY' chip (acid fill, 3px border, hard shadow) and an Archivo Black headline 'Steal a starting point.', plus a 'Browse all 2,000+ ->' underlined link. Below, a 4-card responsive grid (1 / 2 / 4 columns): each card is white with a 4px black border and base hard shadow + press hover, holding a bold phosphor icon, an uppercase title ('Pricing pages', 'Dashboards', 'Auth & sign-up', 'Landing pages'), and a muted count line (e.g. '312 prompts').

### Final CTA + footer
A full-bleed acid-yellow #e8ff00 section with a 4px black top border, centered. Big Archivo Black headline 'Your next UI is one prompt away.', a semibold support line '100 free generations. No card. Cancel the blank-canvas dread today.', and a large black CTA button (acid text, 4px border, base hard shadow, uppercase 'Create your account ->') with the press interaction. Footer: paper bg, 4px black top border, the FORMSET wordmark on the left, a wrap of semibold nav links (with acid hover highlight) in the center, and a mono '(c) 2026 Formset Labs' on the right.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Hard offset drop-shadows with zero blur, in four tiers (4px / 6px / 10px black, plus a layered acid+black variant) used as the core depth language instead of soft shadows.

### Componente
'Press' physical button/card interaction: hover nudges the element up-left (-2px,-2px) and grows the shadow to 8px; active pushes it down-right (3px,3px) and collapses the shadow to 2px, mimicking a physical key press.

### Componente
Focus-reactive inputs: white fields shift -1px,-1px and gain a 5px hard shadow on focus instead of a glow ring.

### Componente
Infinite acid-yellow marquee ticker (CSS translateX keyframe, duplicated content) with mono uppercase feature phrases and star separators.

### Componente
Acid-yellow highlighter knockout on a headline phrase via box-decoration-clone so the highlight wraps cleanly across line breaks.

### Componente
Rotated corner badge ('60-SEC SETUP', ~-8deg) with a lightning icon, black fill / acid text, pinned to the signup card corner on desktop only.

### Componente
Faint 28px x 28px paper grid background (layered linear-gradients at #0000000d) behind hero and library sections.

## Notas Especiais
Strictly no border-radius (every corner is 90 degrees), no gradients on fills, and no blurred shadows — the entire depth model is hard offset shadows. Keep the palette to exactly four values: paper #f4f1ea, ink #000000, acid #e8ff00, and white #ffffff for inputs (grey #6b6b6b only for placeholders). Use 'Archivo Black' only for display/labels, 'Archivo' for body, and 'Space Grotesk' as the uppercase mono voice for tickers/eyebrows/badges. Borders scale with importance: 3px for chips and inputs, 4px for cards/buttons/section dividers. The signup card is the visual anchor — give it the largest shadow (10px) and let everything else support it.
